BMU CANTEEN

HOW TO ORDER IN 4 EASY STEPS

Order hot & fresh food directly from your phone!

No waiting in queues! Browse today's live menu, place your order, and collect hot food when your token number appears on the screen.

SCAN WITH CAMERA
bmu-canteen.onrender.com
1
Scan the QR Code 📱
Open your phone's Camera or Google Lens and point it at the QR code above. Tap the link to open the menu instantly (no app download needed).
iPhone & Android Instant Web Menu
2
Pick Your Favourite Dishes 🍲
Browse live categories: Breakfast, Meals & Thali, Snacks, and Beverages. Tap + Add to put dishes in your cart.
Pure Veg 🟢 Non-Veg 🔴 Custom Portions
3
Enter Name & Choose Payment 💳
Type your Name and Table / Desk Number. Select payment method: UPI / QR, Cash at Counter, or Staff Weekly Tab.
GPay / PhonePe / Paytm Cash Token Issued Instantly
4
Watch TV Board & Collect Hot Food 🔔
Keep your Token Number (e.g. #12). Watch the Public TV Board: When your token turns GREEN (Ready to Collect), come to the counter to pick up your tray!
🟡 Preparing 🟢 Ready for Pickup
